q: Which bridge crew does Kaladin lead in Sadeas's army?
x: Bridge Four began as the unluckiest crew on the Shattered Plains before Kaladin turned it around.

q: What is the name of the Cryptic bonded to Shallan?
x: Pattern hums when pleased and makes Shallan a Lightweaver.

q: When are spheres left out to be infused with Stormlight?
x: Rosharans hang their spheres outside during highstorms so the gems absorb fresh Stormlight.

q: Which younger brother did Kaladin fail to protect in Amaram's army?
x: Tien's death haunts Kaladin, who had joined the army to keep him safe.

q: Which Bridge Four member is a Horneater who cooks for the crew?
x: Rock's stew helps bind the bridgemen together, and as a Horneater he can see spren others cannot.

q: Who travels to Kharbranth hoping to become Jasnah Kholin's ward?
x: Shallan secretly planned to steal Jasnah's Soulcaster to save her family.

q: Which order of Knights Radiant does Kaladin belong to?
x: Windrunners bond honorspren and swear to protect those who cannot protect themselves.

q: Which order of Knights Radiant does Dalinar Kholin join?
x: Dalinar is bonded to the Stormfather, one of the three great spren tied to the Bondsmiths.

q: Which of Shallan's personas is a streetwise spy?
x: Veil wears a white coat and hat and works with the Ghostbloods.

q: What is the name of Lift's cultivationspren?
x: Wyndle was a renowned gardener of chairs in Shadesmar before he was asked to bond Lift.

q: Which greatshell do the Alethi hunt on the Shattered Plains for its gemheart?
x: Winning gemhearts from chasmfiends drives the rivalry between the highprinces.

q: Who assassinated King Gavilar Kholin?
x: Szeth, the Assassin in White, was sent by the Parshendi on the night of the treaty feast.

q: Complete the First Ideal: "Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before..."
x: The First Ideal is shared by all ten orders of the Knights Radiant.

q: Which former member of Bridge Four kills King Elhokar?
x: Moash kills Elhokar during the fall of Kholinar, betraying Kaladin.

q: What color is the lightning of the Everstorm?
x: The Everstorm blows in the opposite direction to the highstorms.

q: Which hand do Vorin women keep covered as their safehand?
x: Exposing the safehand is considered as improper as going out in public undressed.

q: How many orders of Knights Radiant were there?
x: Each order was linked to one of the ten Heralds.

q: What is the ancient city of the Knights Radiant, rediscovered by Shallan?
x: Urithiru is a vast tower reached through Oathgates.

q: In Wind and Truth, to which land does Kaladin travel with Szeth?
x: Kaladin goes to help Szeth confront the corruption in his homeland.

q: What do the Alethi call the people they fight on the Shattered Plains?
x: The Parshendi grow carapace armor and sing as they go into battle.

q: Which of Shallan's brothers was the Shardbearer Kaladin killed in Amaram's army?
x: Helaran bore a Shardblade and Shardplate when Kaladin killed him while saving Amaram.

q: What is the name of Jasnah Kholin's inkspren?
x: Ivory's bond makes Jasnah an Elsecaller, letting her travel into Shadesmar.

q: Which Radiant order does Renarin Kholin join?
x: Renarin's spren Glys was corrupted by the Unmade Sja-anat, letting him see the future.

q: Which spren does Navani Kholin bond?
x: The Sibling is the spren of Urithiru, making Navani a Bondsmith.

q: Which Unmade is the source of the Thrill felt by Alethi warriors?
x: Nergaoul fed the bloodlust of the armies at the Battle of Thaylen Field.

q: Which Herald did not abandon the Oathpact at Aharietiam?
x: Talenel endured torture in Damnation alone for millennia.

q: In which Tashikki city does Edgedancer take place?
x: In Yeddaw, Lift befriends Stump, a woman who runs an orphanage.

q: What kind of creature is Chiri-Chiri, Rysn's pet?
x: Larkins feed on Investiture, and Chiri-Chiri's illness drives Rysn's voyage.

q: Kaladin speaks his Third Ideal while protecting which man he hates?
x: The Third Ideal is: I will protect even those I hate, so long as it is right.

q: Which fabrial lets people write to each other across great distances?
x: A spanreed is made of two pens holding the halves of a split gemstone.

q: Which gemstone do Soulcasters use to turn things into grain and food?
x: This makes emerald broams the most valuable spheres.

q: Which form does Eshonai adopt before the Everstorm is summoned?
x: Stormform is a form of power that lets its bearers channel red lightning.

q: What is the name of Dalinar's late wife, erased from his memory?
x: Dalinar asked the Nightwatcher to take away his pain, and lost his memories of her.

q: Which substance is Teft secretly addicted to?
x: Teft's family belonged to the Envisagers, a cult hoping to bring back the Radiants.

q: What does Venli call the Reacher spren she bonds?
x: Timbre communicates by pulsing to the rhythms and makes Venli a Willshaper.

q: Who becomes the Vessel of Odium at the end of Rhythm of War?
x: Taravangian kills the previous Vessel and takes up the Shard himself.

q: Over how many days does the main story of Wind and Truth unfold?
x: The days count down to the contest of champions agreed with Odium.

q: What are the flying Fused called?
x: Heavenly Ones such as Leshwi glide on the wind using Voidlight.

q: Instead of Ideals, what must Lightweavers speak to progress?
x: Shallan's Truths force her to admit painful facts about her past.

q: Which two Surges do Windrunners command?
x: Kaladin uses Gravitation for Lashings and Adhesion to stick objects together.

q: Which Unmade is known as the Midnight Mother?
x: Re-Shephir lurked in Urithiru until Shallan drove her away.

q: Szeth's Honorblade originally belonged to which Herald?
x: The Shin kept the Honorblades abandoned by the Heralds at Aharietiam.

q: Which Herald is the patron of the Truthwatchers?
x: Pailiah, also called Pali, is the Herald linked to the Truthwatchers and to the Essence of knowledge.

q: Which ancient Alethi conqueror is known as the Sunmaker?
x: The Sunmaker's vast empire fell apart soon after his death.

q: Which Unmade did the Bondsmith Melishi trap in a perfect gem?
x: Her imprisonment is linked to the singers losing their forms and becoming parshmen.

q: Warlight is created by combining Stormlight with what?
x: Navani and Raboniel studied warlight together during the occupation of Urithiru.

q: Which forbidden Aimian city is the goal of Rysn's expedition in Dawnshard?
x: Akinah is guarded by the Sleepless, who keep its secrets hidden.

q: Which Fused is known as the Lady of Wishes?
x: Raboniel organized the Fused occupation of Urithiru.

q: In Wind and Truth, which besieged capital does Adolin help defend?
x: Adolin fights alongside Emperor Yanagawn and Commandant Kushkam without any Radiant powers.

q: In Dawnshard, which Windrunner swears his Third Ideal to protect Lopen?
x: Huio is a Herdazian Windrunner sent with Lopen to guard Rysn on the voyage.

q: Which character is known as the Survivor of Hathsin?
x: Kelsier earned the title by escaping the Pits of Hathsin, where the Lord Ruler's prisoners mined atium.

q: Burning which metal lets an Allomancer push on nearby metals?
x: Coinshots use steel Pushes to fling coins or launch themselves through the air.

q: What does burning pewter enhance in an Allomancer?
x: Thugs, or Pewterarms, burn pewter to fight and endure wounds that would stop others.

q: What is the name of Vin's older brother, who raised her on the streets?
x: Reen taught Vin to trust no one, a lesson she struggles to unlearn.

q: What is the capital city of the Final Empire?
x: Luthadel is home to the Great Houses and the Lord Ruler's palace.

q: What are the Lord Ruler's servants with metal spikes through their eyes called?
x: Inquisitors gain their powers through Hemalurgy, using spikes driven into their bodies.

q: To which noble house does Elend belong?
x: House Venture was one of the most powerful Great Houses of Luthadel.

q: Sazed is a Keeper from which people?
x: Terris Keepers are Feruchemists who store memories of lost religions and lore.

q: What colour is the skin of a koloss?
x: A koloss's blue skin does not grow with its body, so it stretches and tears as the creature gets bigger.

q: Which member of Kelsier's crew is a Soother?
x: Breeze burns brass to calm and nudge the emotions of those around him.

q: Burning which metal lets an Allomancer see a few seconds into the future?
x: Atium shows shadows of what people are about to do, making its user almost unbeatable in a fight.

q: What are the metal objects in which Feruchemists store attributes called?
x: Sazed wears metalminds as bracers, rings and earrings to store memories, weight and more.

q: Who releases Ruin at the Well of Ascension?
x: Ruin tricked Vin into releasing the Well's power instead of taking it, freeing him from his prison.

q: Who becomes Harmony at the end of The Hero of Ages?
x: By taking up both Ruin and Preservation, Sazed becomes the Shard holder known as Harmony.

q: Who gave Vin the earring she always wears?
x: The earring was actually a Hemalurgic spike that let Ruin whisper to Vin.

q: What was the Lord Ruler's real name?
x: Rashek was a Terris packman who took the power at the Well of Ascension for himself.

q: Which kandra secretly took the place of OreSeur at Vin's side?
x: Zane ordered TenSoon to kill OreSeur and take his place to spy on Vin.

q: Kandra imitate people by digesting a corpse and then using its what?
x: A kandra rebuilds the body's flesh around the skeleton, copying the person's looks.

q: Where was the Well of Ascension finally found?
x: Everyone sought it in the Terris Mountains, but it lay in a cavern under the capital.

q: Which god metal can turn an ordinary person into a Mistborn?
x: Lerasium is the metal form of Preservation's power.

q: What was the name of Kelsier's wife, who died in the Pits of Hathsin?
x: Mare, a Tineye, was imprisoned in the Pits along with Kelsier and died there.

q: What is a Misting who can only burn iron called?
x: A Lurcher Pulls on metals, drawing them toward himself or himself toward them.

q: If an Allomancer burns duralumin with another metal, what happens to that metal?
x: Vin uses duralumin bursts to gain enormous, short-lived surges of power.

q: What does burning malatium, the Eleventh Metal, reveal?
x: Vin burned it on the Lord Ruler and glimpsed the man he once was.

q: What is the name of the Lord Ruler's palace in Luthadel?
x: Its name means 'the Hill of a Thousand Spires'.

q: Which Terriswoman tutors Elend on how to behave like a king?
x: Tindwyl is a Keeper who is fascinated by historical leaders.

q: Which warlord, Elend's own father, besieges Luthadel?
x: Straff was one of several warlords who surrounded Luthadel at once.

q: Who was the man believed to be the Hero of Ages, whose place the Lord Ruler stole?
x: Rashek killed Alendi on the journey to the Well and took the power himself.

q: What does burning aluminum do to an Allomancer?
x: Inquisitors used aluminum to strip captured Allomancers of their powers.

q: From which creatures were the kandra originally created?
x: The Lord Ruler gave Hemalurgic spikes to mistwraiths, granting them sentience.

q: In which city does most of The Alloy of Law take place?
x: Elendel is the capital of the Elendel Basin, named after Elend Venture.

q: Wayne is famous for his skill with what?
x: Wayne collects hats and other items to help him slip into a new persona.

q: Which woman does Wax become engaged to in The Alloy of Law?
x: Steris approaches the engagement like a business deal, complete with a detailed contract.

q: Which religion of era 2 worships Kelsier?
x: Survivorists revere Kelsier as the Survivor who overthrew the Lord Ruler.

q: The Bands of Mourning are said to be the metalminds of whom?
x: Legends say they could grant all of the Lord Ruler's powers to whoever wore them.

q: Which character's story after death is told in Secret History?
x: Kelsier clung to the Cognitive Realm and kept working behind the scenes of era 1.

q: Who is the man known as Mister Suit?
x: Mister Suit, the man behind Miles and the Vanishers, is Wax's own uncle.

q: Who turns out to be the killer known as Bleeder?
x: Wax's beloved Lessie had been the kandra Paalm all along.

q: What do followers of the Path wear while they pray?
x: Wax, a Pathian, often touches his earring when praying or thinking things over.

q: Which gunsmith, an old friend of Wax and Wayne, builds them weapons?
x: Ranette has threatened to shoot Wayne on sight, and has actually shot him more than once.

q: Which metal does Wax use as a Feruchemist to change his weight?
x: Wax is a Twinborn: a Coinshot and a Skimmer, and he combines the two to fly.

q: By what title is Vin revered in era 2?
x: In era 2 Elend is the Last Emperor and Spook is the Lord Mistborn.

q: Which major character dies in The Lost Metal?
x: Wayne gives his life to stop the Set's bomb, a heavy loss for Wax and Marasi.

q: By what name are the kandra known to the people of Elendel?
x: Most people in Elendel see the kandra as half-mythical servants of Harmony.

q: Which god does the Set serve?
x: Trell is in fact a guise of Autonomy, a Shard from beyond Scadrial.

q: From which southern nation does the pilot Allik come?
x: Like other Malwish, Allik wears a mask and uses medallions to access the Metallic Arts.

q: In The Eleventh Metal, who trains Kelsier in Allomancy?
x: Gemmel is an eccentric, seemingly mad Mistborn.

q: Who is the Terris steward who edits Allomancer Jak's stories?
x: Handerwym's footnotes politely cast doubt on Jak's wildest claims.

q: What do the southern Scadrians use to let anyone access Feruchemy?
x: The medallions are unkeyed metalminds, usable by people with no powers of their own.

q: Which era 1 character is known in era 2 as Ironeyes?
x: Marsh still serves Harmony centuries later and is feared as a figure of legend.

q: Who is Raoden's father?
x: Iadon, a former merchant, became King of Arelon after the Reod.

q: Which kingdom is Princess Sarene from?
x: Sarene, daughter of King Eventeo, comes to Arelon to marry Prince Raoden.

q: From which nation does the gyorn Hrathen come?
x: Hrathen is sent from Fjorden to convert Arelon before it is too late.

q: Which religion does Hrathen preach in Arelon?
x: Hrathen tries to turn the Arelenes away from Shu-Korath and towards Shu-Dereth.

q: Galladon, Raoden's first friend in Elantris, comes from which country?
x: Galladon is a Dula who was taken by the Shaod and thrown into Elantris.

q: What is the name of Sarene's seon?
x: Like every seon, Ashe is named after an Aon, which glows at its center.

q: What is the transformation that turns ordinary people into Elantrians called?
x: Before the Reod, the Shaod made people godlike; afterwards it left them cursed.

q: What was the catastrophe that ruined Elantris ten years before the novel?
x: In the Reod, Elantrians lost their powers and their city fell into filth and decay.

q: What alias does Raoden use inside Elantris to hide his identity?
x: The name comes from Aon Rao, the Aon in Raoden's own name, which means spirit.

q: After the Reod, what happens to a cut an Elantrian receives?
x: Elantrians' hearts no longer beat, and every wound keeps hurting forever.

q: What is the magic of drawing Aons in the air called?
x: AonDor drew its power from the Dor and stopped working after the Reod.

q: Who is Sarene's uncle, living in Kae with his family?
x: Kiin is the brother of King Eventeo of Teod and a superb cook.

q: What is the community Raoden builds inside the fallen city called?
x: Raoden unites the city's gangs and gives the Elantrians work to fight their pain.

q: In which kingdom does the city of Elantris stand?
x: Elantrians once ruled Arelon, until the Reod brought them down.

q: Who becomes King of Arelon at the end of Elantris?
x: Restored as a true Elantrian, Raoden takes the throne with Sarene at his side.

q: How long does the Wyrn give Hrathen to convert Arelon before Fjorden destroys it?
x: Hrathen knows Arelon will be invaded if he fails within that deadline.

q: From which city does King Iadon rule Arelon after the Reod?
x: Kae is one of the four cities around Elantris; the others were abandoned after the Reod.

q: What effect does Aon Daa produce when drawn by an Elantrian?
x: Aon Daa means power or energy and was the Elantrians' preferred weapon.

q: What are Elantrians called who are overwhelmed by pain and can only moan?
x: Their wounds never heal, so pain accumulates until the Elantrian's mind gives way.

q: How does Hrathen stage a fake 'cure' for the Shaod?
x: After being locked in Elantris, he takes an antidote and claims Jaddeth cured him.

q: What is the Derethi priest Dilaf secretly?
x: Dilaf's bones were reshaped in the Dakhor monastery, granting him dark powers.

q: Which country is the baron Shuden from?
x: Shuden is a skilled practitioner of the JinDo martial art ChayShan.

q: What event broke AonDor and caused the Reod?
x: The resulting chasm changed the land of Arelon, which the Aons are tied to, so every Aon needed a new line.

q: Who is the god worshipped by the followers of Shu-Dereth?
x: The Derethi believe Jaddeth will rise from beneath the earth once all people are united.

q: Why is Sarene considered Raoden's widow despite never meeting him?
x: The treaty stated that if either betrothed died, the marriage would count as binding.

q: What is Raoden's seon, which loses its sanity after his Shaod, called?
x: A seon whose master is taken by the broken Shaod goes mad.

q: What does Aon Ien do in AonDor?
x: Healing with Aon Ien required modifiers specifying which part of the body to mend.

q: Which secret cult did King Iadon practise, sacrificing his own staff?
x: After Sarene exposed him, Iadon was arrested and took his own life in prison.

q: Which nobleman was Sarene about to marry when she was cast into Elantris?
x: On the wedding day she appeared to be taken by the Shaod (really another dose of Hrathen's potion), and Telrii took the throne.

q: From which older religion do both Shu-Dereth and Shu-Korath derive?
x: Shu-Keseg originated in JinDo and taught the unity of all mankind.

q: Before coming to Arelon, Hrathen had instigated a revolution in which country?
x: The bloodshed in Duladel haunted Hrathen and shaped his doubts about Wyrn's plans.

q: Which member of Kiin's family has been secretly hidden as an Elantrian?
x: Kiin and Daora hid Adien's Shaod so he would not be thrown into Elantris.

q: What kind of Selish magic does Shai practise?
x: Shai is considered one of the best Forgers in the Rose Empire.

q: Whose soul must Shai recreate in The Emperor's Soul?
x: Assassins left Emperor Ashravan alive but with his mind destroyed.

q: Which elderly arbiter slowly comes to respect Shai's art?
x: Unlike the other arbiters, Gaotona comes to see Forgery as a true art.

q: In which empire is The Emperor's Soul set?
x: Ashravan is the forty-ninth emperor of the Rose Empire.

q: What does a Forger change with a soulstamp?
x: A Forgery holds only if the rewritten past is plausible for the object.

q: What was Shai caught trying to steal?
x: The Imperial Fool betrayed her, swapping her copy back for the real scepter.

q: How long a mourning period do the arbiters have to hide the emperor's state?
x: If Ashravan did not reappear in time, the Heritage Faction would lose power.

q: To which faction do Ashravan and his arbiters belong?
x: The faction depends on the emperor's survival to keep ruling the empire.

q: Which ambitious arbiter is the most powerful of the emperor's councillors?
x: Frava secretly intends to control the restored emperor and to be rid of Shai.

q: Who is the captain of the guard who threatens to kill Shai one day?
x: Zu is a Striker who personally escorts Shai to the arbiters.

q: What do Bloodsealers use as ink in their stamps?
x: With it, a Bloodsealer can animate skeletons to hunt down a target.

q: What does an Essence Mark rewrite?
x: Shai uses Essence Marks to briefly gain skills she does not normally have.

q: Which major award did The Emperor's Soul win in 2013?
x: It won the Hugo for Best Novella.

q: Which rival faction is blamed for the attempt on Ashravan's life?
x: An emperor's death would favour the Glory Faction's bid for the succession.

q: Which people of the Rose Empire does Shai belong to?
x: Shai is a MaiPon, one of the peoples living within the Rose Empire.

q: Who is the protagonist of The Hope of Elantris?
x: Matisse protects the children of New Elantris on the night of the Dakhor attack.

q: Which Shard Splintered Devotion and Dominion on Sel?
x: Odium attacked the two Shards and left their power trapped around Sel.

q: What is the Dor, the power behind Selish magic?
o: The trapped power of two Shards
x: Odium sealed the Investiture of the Splintered Devotion and Dominion in Sel's Cognitive Realm, where it forms the Dor.

q: Who is sent to T'Telir to marry the God King of Hallandren?
x: Siri, the youngest princess of Idris, is sent in place of her older sister Vivenna.

q: From which kingdom do Siri and Vivenna come?
x: Idris is a small, austere highland kingdom north of Hallandren.

q: What is the capital city of Hallandren?
x: T'Telir is a colorful coastal city that houses the Court of Gods.

q: Lightsong is worshipped in Hallandren as the god of what?
x: Ironically, Lightsong doubts his own divinity and prefers jokes to heroics.

q: What is the purpose Nightblood was Awakened to fulfil?
x: Nightblood has no clear idea of what evil actually is, which makes it terribly dangerous.

q: Why is the God King Susebron unable to speak?
o: He took a vow of silence
x: His priests removed his tongue so he could never use his vast store of Breath to Awaken.

q: Who serves as Lightsong's high priest?
x: Lightsong nicknames the patient Llarimar "Scoot".

q: Who is the king of Idris and father of Siri and Vivenna?
x: Dedelin sends Siri instead of Vivenna, hoping to keep his heir-trained daughter safe.

q: Which mercenary leader works for Vivenna in T'Telir?
x: Denth seems a friendly hireling, but he is secretly working to start the war.

q: Besides Breath, what does Awakening draw from nearby objects?
x: Objects used as a source of color turn grey once the Awakening is done.

q: In Hallandren, what is a person called who has no Breath at all?
x: Drabs see colors as duller and are often shunned by others.

q: What are the Lifeless that make up Hallandren's armies?
x: Lifeless can be created with a single Breath and follow simple Commands.

q: What can members of the Idrian royal family do with their hair?
x: The Royal Locks shift color with emotion, which Siri struggles to control.

q: What do the Returned usually lose when they come back from death?
x: Returned keep only vague dreams and impressions of who they were.

q: Which princess had been betrothed to the God King since birth?
x: Vivenna trained her whole life for the marriage, only to see Siri sent instead.

q: What is the name of the god worshipped in Idris?
x: Austrism teaches humility and frowns on bright colors and ostentation.

q: Blushweaver is the Hallandren goddess of what?
x: Blushweaver uses her political cunning to push the Court of Gods toward war with Idris.

q: To which people does the palace scribe Bluefingers belong?
x: Bluefingers plots a war between Hallandren and Idris to free the Pahn Kahl.

q: How often must a Returned absorb a new Breath to stay alive?
x: Hallandren citizens donate these Breaths, which keep the gods' Divine Breath going.

q: How many Heightenings of Breath are there?
x: The Tenth Heightening requires around 50,000 Breaths, a level held by the God King.

q: How does Lightsong save Susebron at the climax of Warbreaker?
x: The gift heals Susebron's tongue but costs Lightsong his life.

q: Which legendary figure who ended the Manywar is revealed to be Vasher?
x: Peacegiver ended the war by giving his treasure of Breath to the line of God Kings.

q: Where are Kalad's Phantoms secretly hidden in T'Telir?
x: The Phantoms are Lifeless made of bones encased in stone, posing as statues.

q: Shashara, Vasher's former lover, was the sister of which mercenary?
x: Vasher killed Shashara, which fuels Denth's hatred of him.

q: On Roshar, Vasher goes by Zahel. What does he do for Adolin?
x: Zahel is a sharp-tongued ardent and dueling master in the Kholin warcamp.

q: Under what name does Vivenna appear in Kholinar in Oathbringer?
x: As Azure, she commands the Wall Guard defending Kholinar.

q: Who receives Nightblood at the end of Words of Radiance?
x: The Herald Nale gives the talking sword to Szeth after reviving him, though Szeth does not know its name.

q: In the prologue, from which imprisoned rebel does Vasher obtain Breath?
x: Vahr had led a rebellion against Hallandren and hoarded Breath before his capture.

q: What are the Tears of Edgli, a major source of Hallandren's wealth?
x: Their vibrant dyes fuel the color trade that makes Hallandren rich.

q: Which dying Idrian spy passes his large store of Breath to Vivenna?
x: Lemex was being secretly poisoned by Denth, and the sudden Breath leaves Vivenna overwhelmed.

q: Who is the high priest of the God King Susebron?
x: Treledees dies defending Siri and Susebron during the Pahn Kahl rebellion.

q: How do Siri and Susebron first manage to talk to each other?
x: Their secret written conversations happen at night in the God King's bedchamber.

q: As one of the Five Scholars, Vasher was known by what name?
x: As Talaxin, he created Nightblood together with Shashara.

q: Clod, the Lifeless in Denth's crew, was once which of the Five Scholars?
x: Arsteel was killed by Vasher in a duel and later turned into a Lifeless.

q: Which of the Five Scholars discovered ichor-alcohol for Lifeless?
x: Ichor-alcohol replaces a Lifeless's blood and makes it far more durable.

q: Mercystar, whose palace is broken into, is the goddess of what?
x: Blushweaver uses the break-in to persuade Mercystar to join her preparations for war.

q: Who is the Vessel of the Shard Endowment?
x: Her name lives on in the Tears of Edgli, the flowers behind Hallandren's dyes.

q: Which Heightening makes an Awakener stop aging?
x: It takes about 2,000 Breaths, and every Returned enjoys its benefits automatically.

q: How did the man who became Lightsong die?
x: In life he was Stennimar, the brother of his future high priest Llarimar.

q: What is the capital city of Idris?
x: Bevalis is a small city in a mountain valley, modest beside Hallandren's capital.

q: On which planet is Tress of the Emerald Sea set?
x: Lumar is a world of spore oceans fed by twelve moons, each hosting an aether.

q: What does Tress love to collect at the start of her story?
x: Tress treasures her cups for the stories each one seems to tell.

q: What kind of animal is Huck, Tress's talking companion?
x: Huck is a cursed talking rat who secretly spies for the Sorceress.

q: Who is Charlie, the young man Tress sets out to rescue?
x: The duke sent Charlie to the Midnight Sea, where he was captured by the Sorceress.

q: Who captains the pirate ship Crow's Song when Tress joins its crew?
x: Captain Crow is a ruthless pirate whom Tress eventually outwits.

q: What happens when verdant spores come into contact with water?
x: Sailors use verdant vines as fuses or to entangle opponents.

q: Which spores release a burst of air when wet, making them ideal for firing cannons?
x: Zephyr spores fall on the Sapphire Sea and are used to propel cannonballs.

q: What is Fort's position aboard the Crow's Song?
x: Fort is deaf and communicates through a Nalthian board.

q: What does Dr. Ulaam, the Crow's Song's surgeon, ask for as payment?
x: Hoid claims Ulaam is the best doctor he has ever met, despite his odd fee.

q: Who does the crew elect as captain after Crow is removed?
x: Tress trades Crow to the dragon Xisis, and the grateful crew chooses her to lead.

q: What is the name of the new ship Tress and her crew buy at the end of the story?
x: Pardoned by the king, the crew sell the Crow's Song and buy the Two Cups, with Charlie aboard as valet, storyteller and musician.

q: In which of Lumar's seas does the dragon Xisis make his home?
x: Xisis is a dragon originally from Yolen who, for a time, made his home in the Crimson Sea.

q: On which planet do Yumi and Painter live?
x: Komashi is the world where the Shard Virtuosity Splintered herself.

q: What does Yumi stack into delicate towers to summon spirits?
x: The spirits she draws grant blessings to the villagers of her land.

q: What does Painter hunt and capture with his brush and ink?
x: Nightmares seep out of the shroud, and painters trap them by painting them into harmless images.

q: What sacred title does Yumi hold among her people?
x: A yoki-hijo summons spirits for her people at great cost to her own freedom.

q: What is Painter's real name?
x: Nikaro usually goes by Painter, after his job as a nightmare painter.

q: What hangs permanently over the city of Kilahito?
x: Under the shroud Kilahito lives in constant darkness, lit by glowing hion lines.

q: In which two colors do Kilahito's hion lines glow?
x: Hion lines run through the city, providing both light and power.

q: Who is Yumi's strict guardian and attendant?
x: Liyun oversees Yumi's rigid daily rituals as a yoki-hijo.

q: Which of these characters is a fellow nightmare painter in Kilahito?
x: Painter meets Akane and Tojin on patrol at the city's western edge.

q: What is Masaka, who works as a nightmare painter, secretly?
x: Masaka hides her true nature and later helps Yumi and Design map the lands beyond the shroud.

q: Which Shard Splintered herself on Komashi?
x: The remnants of Virtuosity's power shaped the strange Investiture of Komashi.

q: On which planet is The Sunlit Man set?
x: Canticle is a world scorched by a deadly, Invested sun.

q: Why must the cities of Canticle keep constantly moving?
x: Anyone caught in Canticle's direct sunlight is burned to ash.

q: Who is the woman Nomad befriends and helps on Canticle?
x: Rain becomes Nomad's key ally in standing against the Cinder King.

q: By what name was Nomad known when he lived on Roshar?
x: Sigzil was a member of Bridge Four before becoming the worldhopping Nomad.

q: Which group hunts Nomad from world to world?
x: Nomad keeps Skipping between planets to stay ahead of the Night Brigade.

q: Which tyrant do Nomad and Rain oppose on Canticle?
x: The Cinder King commands the Charred, people enslaved by a corrupted sunheart driven into their chests.

q: What does Nomad's Torment make him unable to do?
x: The Torment stops him from causing harm even in self-defense.

q: What is the cause of Nomad's Torment?
x: Holding a Dawnshard leaves a lasting mark on whoever carried it.

q: What kind of being is Auxiliary, Nomad's talking companion?
x: Aux was nearly destroyed by the Dawnshard Nomad once held and survives as a voice in Nomad's head.

q: On which planet is White Sand set?
x: Taldain is tidally locked, split into an eternal Dayside and Darkside.

q: What do Sand Masters expend from their own bodies to control sand?
x: Overusing sand mastery can dangerously dehydrate a Sand Master.

q: Who is Kenton's father, the powerful Lord Mastrell?
x: Praxton dies fighting the Kerztians, his final attack burying Kenton in sand.

q: What color does white sand turn after a Sand Master uses it?
x: Spent sand turns white again after about four hours in Dayside's sunlight.

q: What is distinctive about Taldain's Darkside?
o: It always faces a dim star
x: Khriss hails from Darkside, which faces a white dwarf hidden behind a particle ring.

q: What is the name of the order of Sand Masters that Kenton belongs to?
x: Kenton eventually becomes Lord Mastrell, leader of the Diem.

q: Which Shard Invests Taldain through its blazing larger star?
x: Taldain orbits a blue-white supergiant paired with a dim white dwarf.

q: On which planet is Sixth of the Dusk set?
x: First of the Sun is an ocean world dotted with deadly islands.

q: What are the talent-granting birds of First of the Sun called?
x: Young Aviar must visit the island of Patji to gain their talents.

q: What is Dusk's profession?
x: Dusk traps Aviar on Patji, as was the tradition among his people.

q: Patji, the largest island of the Pantheon, is often called what?
x: Trappers like Dusk treat the deadly island of Patji with wary reverence, as a stern father.

q: What does Dusk's Aviar Sak show him?
x: Sak's corpse visions warn Dusk of danger ahead; her talent was unknown among Aviar before her.

q: What talent does Dusk's Aviar Kokerlii grant him?
x: On Patji, many predators hunt by sensing minds, so Kokerlii is vital.

q: On which planet do the Forests of Hell grow?
x: The Forests of Hell are haunted by shades, the spirits of the dead.

q: What does Silence Montane run in the Forests of Hell?
x: Silence runs the waystop with her daughter, William Ann.

q: Which metal can destroy the shades of Threnody?
x: Shades grow enraged if someone lights a fire, runs at night or sheds blood.

q: Under what secret identity does Silence hunt bounties?
x: Silence uses the bounties she collects to keep her waystop out of debt.

q: What became of Silence's grandmother after she was killed?
o: Her shade is bound in a shrine
She was buried in the Homeland
x: Silence's grandmother came from the Homeland before it fell to the Evil.

q: The Shards of the Cosmere are pieces of which ancient being?
x: Adonalsium was broken in the Shattering, and its power was divided among the Shards.

q: How many Shards was Adonalsium split into?
x: Each of the sixteen Shards embodies a single Intent, such as Honor, Ruin or Endowment.

q: Besides Honor and Cultivation, which Shard is present in the Rosharan system?
x: Odium came to Roshar long ago, and Honor and Cultivation bound him to the system.

q: Which Shard was responsible for the death of Honor?
x: Odium Splintered Honor, leaving the Stormfather as one of his largest remnants.

q: Which two Shards worked together to create humankind on Scadrial?
x: Ruin agreed in exchange for being allowed to destroy the world later, but Preservation betrayed and imprisoned him at great cost to himself.

q: Stormlight is the Investiture of which Shard?
x: Cultivation's power appears as Lifelight and Odium's as Voidlight.

q: Who takes up Preservation's power to fight Ruin directly?
x: Vin and Ruin destroyed each other in their final clash.

q: Atium turns out to be the concentrated body of which Shard?
x: Ruin hid his body as atium, which was mined in the Pits of Hathsin.

q: On Roshar, what is the Cognitive Realm commonly called?
x: Jasnah and Shallan can glimpse and even slip into Shadesmar through Soulcasting.

q: The Physical and Cognitive Realms are two of the three Realms. What is the third?
x: The Spiritual Realm holds a thing's ideal form and is outside time and space.

q: What position does Hoid hold at King Elhokar's court?
x: As Wit he insults courtiers for a living, yet keeps his true purpose hidden.

q: Which worldhopper narrates Tress of the Emerald Sea?
x: Hoid tells the story of Tress, a young woman of the island world Lumar.

q: Which sentient sword from Nalthis ends up on Roshar?
x: Nightblood was Awakened on Nalthis with the Command to destroy evil.

q: Which Rosharan carries Nightblood in Oathbringer?
x: Szeth trains with the Skybreakers under Nale while bearing Nightblood.

q: Which secret society, through its agent Mraize, recruits Shallan?
x: In Words of Radiance, Mraize has Shallan, disguised as Veil, spy on Amaram's Sons of Honor.

q: Which was the first Cosmere novel to be published?
x: Elantris came out in 2005, set on the planet Sel.

q: What is the general Cosmere term for the power of the Shards in all its forms?
x: Stormlight, Breath and the Dor are all forms of Investiture on their respective worlds.

q: What makes up the 'ocean' of Shadesmar?
x: Each bead represents an object in the Physical Realm, and touching one reveals its nature.

q: The Stormfather is a remnant of which Shard?
x: After Honor's death, the Stormfather retained fragments of his power and memories.

q: Which worldhopper is the protagonist of The Sunlit Man?
x: Nomad keeps jumping between worlds to escape the Night Brigade.

q: What is the name of the Shard formed when Ruin and Preservation are held together?
x: Sazed, as Harmony, is worshipped by the people of Elendel in the second Mistborn era.

q: What is the person who holds a Shard's power called?
x: A Sliver, by contrast, is someone who once held a Shard and then let it go.

q: Which Shard is invested on Nalthis, the world of Warbreaker?
x: Endowment gives each person a single Breath and sends the Returned back to life.

q: Allomancy draws its power from which Shard?
x: The metals only act as a catalyst for Preservation's power, while Hemalurgy is tied to Ruin.

q: In The Lost Metal, the god Trell is revealed to be a guise of which Shard?
x: Harmony tells Wax that Autonomy acts through independent avatars, and Trell is one of them.

q: In The Lost Metal, which group led by Kelsier invites Marasi to join it?
x: Marasi works with the Ghostblood agents Moonlight and TwinSoul, but turns down Kelsier's offer.

q: After his death, in which Realm does Kelsier linger in Mistborn: Secret History?
x: Kelsier refuses to pass into the Beyond and survives as a Cognitive Shadow.

q: Which worldhopper is the in-world author of the planetary essays in Arcanum Unbounded?
x: Khriss is a scholar of the Cosmere who studies its worlds and magic systems.

q: From which planet does the scholar Khriss come?
x: Khriss is a Darksider who travels to Taldain's Dayside in White Sand.

q: Which two Shards were Splintered on Sel?
x: Their scattered power fuels the Dor, the source of Selish magic such as AonDor.

q: In Warbreaker, which god summons Hoid to the Court of Gods to tell stories?
x: Hoid recounts the history of the first Returned and the origin of the God Kings.

q: What musical instrument does Hoid leave with Kaladin?
x: Hoid plays it while telling the story of Derethil and the Wandersail, then tells Kaladin to keep it.

q: Which Cryptic, once intended to bond Elhokar, ends up bonded to Hoid?
x: Through this bond Hoid becomes a Lightweaver.

q: What is the name of Hoid's homeworld?
x: Yolen is where Adonalsium was Shattered, and is the setting of the planned Dragonsteel books.

q: Under what name does Vasher work as a swordmaster on Roshar?
x: Zahel trains Adolin, and his speech hints at the colors and Breath of Nalthis.

q: What is a place where a Shard's power pools and links the Realms, allowing travel between them?
x: Worldhoppers often use Perpendicularities to enter and leave the Cognitive Realm.

q: On Scadrial, which place is Preservation's Perpendicularity?
x: In Secret History, the dead Kelsier spends years by the Well, where Preservation's power pools.

q: What keeps Odium from leaving the Rosharan system?
x: Odium seeks a contest of champions as a way to escape this binding.

q: Who does Dalinar learn is the true identity of the old woman of the Valley?
x: Cultivation lives in the Valley alongside the Nightwatcher, a powerful spren.

q: How does Odium describe himself to Dalinar?
x: Odium insists he embodies every passion, not only hatred.

q: With which weapon does Taravangian kill Rayse?
x: Nightblood's hunger for Investiture let it destroy the Vessel of a Shard.

q: Who was the Vessel of Odium before Taravangian?
x: Rayse had held Odium since the Shattering of Adonalsium.

q: Who was the original Vessel of Ruin?
x: Holding Ruin for millennia gradually twisted Ati's mind toward its Intent.

q: According to Harmony in The Lost Metal, who holds the Shard Autonomy?
x: Bavadin's Autonomy works through many independent avatars, such as Trell.

q: Which Shard did Odium mortally wound in the Threnodite system?
x: Ambition survived that clash but was later Splintered somewhere else.

q: Which worldhopper collects maps and artifacts for Khriss and annotates the charts?
x: Nazh's handwritten notes appear on several of the maps and illustrations in the books.

q: The Elantrian Galladon is a member of which worldhopper society?
x: The Seventeenth Shard opposes meddling with the Shards and their worlds.

q: In which region of Roshar is Cultivation's Perpendicularity?
x: The Unkalaki tell of a sacred lake there that leads to the realm of the gods.

q: Who is the masked Ghostblood who serves as Mraize's babsk?
x: Iyatil is a worldhopper who always keeps her face hidden behind a mask.

q: Which offworld Ghostblood agent uses soulstamps in The Lost Metal?
x: Soulstamps are a Selish art, the same one practised in The Emperor's Soul.
